title: 10k on Instagram
content: Thanks toAsh Faulknerfor following me onInstagramand being the one to push me over the 10K mark. I started up with Instagram 14 weeks ago, and I love the forum it provides artists.If you want to check out my IG postings, you'll find a daily serving of my artwork, both new and old, familiar and obscure, plus a few fun video clips.----James Gurney on Instagram
